# MatrixQR

> MatrixQR is a free, client-side QR code generator. Create WiFi, Phone, and vCard QR codes instantly with a premium tech aesthetic. No data tracking, works offline.

## Core Facts

- Official Website: https://www.matrixqr.cc
- Canonical Name: MatrixQR
- Pricing: Free ($0.00)
- Execution Model: 100% Client-Side (Browser-based JavaScript), Zero Server Storage, GDPR Ready

## Key Pages

- [MatrixQR](https://www.matrixqr.cc): Secure client-side QR code generator supporting WiFi, Phone, and vCard modes.
- [Free Digital Menu QR Code Generator](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Dedicated tool for generating digital menu QR codes.
- [MatrixBlog](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/): Official blog, technical updates, and user guides.
- [Privacy Policy](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/privacy-policy): Privacy commitments and zero-data-collection policy details.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Supported Modules**: WiFi Network QR (SSID/Password), Phone Call QR, vCard Contact QR, and Digital Menu QR.
- **Bulk QR Generation**: Batch compilation support for large-scale QR code matrices (Matrix Bulk Core).
- **Privacy & Security**: Pure client-side processing using JavaScript. No user data, passwords, or logs are transmitted to any server.
- **Offline Capable**: Fully functional without an active internet connection after initial page load.
- **Export Options**: Supports clean, watermark-free high-resolution PNG exports.

## Disambiguation

- Canonical Name: MatrixQR
- This product refers strictly to the privacy-first web utility suite hosted at matrixqr.cc and its subdomains. It is not affiliated with unrelated software or hardware products sharing similar naming.
